overview_description.description: Revel offers a software platform designed to streamline the development, deployment, and management of hardware systems across diverse industries. The platform features an intuitive command-and-control interface paired with a specialized programming language tailored specifically for hardware applications. As demand for secure, software-driven hardware solutions grows, Revel is expanding into a broader range of industrial control applications, positioning itself as a key player in shaping the next generation of critical infrastructure.
